_comment: Hand-maintained pending actions merged into pending-actions.json by build-pending-actions.py. Scraped [data-webmaster] notes live on the pages themselves; put site-wide or cross-page issues here. Delete an entry when resolved and re-run the builder.

entries.title: Navigation label: High Power - High Voltage

notes.text: TODO (2026-07-02, added for David): Rename the navigation label 'High Power/Current Pulsers' to 'High Voltage/Current Pulsers' in the Application Briefs and Technical Notes dropdown group headings. The nav menu is baked into every page, so this is a site-wide change across ~289 pages (only ~7 were updated before we paused; all the rest still read 'High Power/Current Pulsers'). Best done as a scripted repo-wide find-and-replace of '<div class="nav-grp2">High Power/Current Pulsers' -> '<div class="nav-grp2">High Voltage/Current Pulsers' rather than editing 289 pages by hand. Note: the top product menu item and the /dei-home.html page may also still say 'High Power/Current Pulsers' - confirm whether those should change too.

entries.title: DEI High Power/Current Pulsers line page

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the page's previous meta description claimed 300 kV, but the page content says 30 kV max for DC supplies. Confirm the correct top-line voltage for the DEI line; the new meta avoids the number until engineering confirms.

notes.text: SEO sweep 2026-07-08 (verify): the 745T datasheet page states 1 ps resolution while the user-manual page states about 0.25 ps. Confirm the published spec and align both pages.
